get.description: One post: labels, frozen forecast, score and captures. Accepts `post:12` or `12`.
The latest run's briefing: summary lines, notable posts with record ids, caveats, spend.
The latest run and any unfinished run, step by step, with a classified failure if any.

post.description:
Run now, or resume an interrupted run, and return the new briefing.

Blocks until the run ends (seconds to a minute). It runs in the server's thread pool, so it
finishes even if the browser goes away; poll ``GET /api/runs/status`` meanwhile. If another
run holds the lock, returns at once and the status shows that run.

get.description: Planned posts: upcoming ones with their frozen ranges, and recent ones (posted or missed).

post.description: Register a planned post and freeze its forecast now, before the post exists.
The forecast a planned post would get, with guardrail warnings. Freezes nothing.

409.description: No owner account yet: run once first

get.description: Running, waiting and concluded experiments, E01-E09 with power previews, pending approvals.

post.description:
Start a suggestion or a custom experiment as the owner: scheduled directly, or a pending
approval for MODEL §6.9's owner items (horizons over 8 weeks, a 4th concurrent experiment).

Register whole local days (up to 7 ahead) for every scheduled or active experiment.
Each slot's treatment-blind forecast is frozen before its arms are drawn.

get.description: Protocol, slots with arms and blind ranges, readouts, guardrails, deviations, e-LOND.

post.description:
Register whole days for this experiment only (other running experiments draw nothing
on these days; use ``POST /api/experiments/slots`` to run them as a factorial).
Stop for good: planned treated slots revert to control and no e-value is emitted.
MODEL §6.3's one extension of up to 50% (past 8 weeks it becomes a pending approval).
The owner approves a pending item. No MCP tool can reach this.

get.description: Registered slots and planned posts for the next days, with arm instructions and frozen ranges.
The Forecasts screen: model card, release gates, calibration, drift monitors, changes.

post.description: Acknowledge a detector alarm. Nothing else changes.

get.description: The Account screen's follower panels: tiles, follower forecast band, funnel, goal, past.
Current goals with their status, and every goal ever set.

post.description: Set a goal: supersedes the scope's current goal and starts a new period (logged).
Where you'd stand today against a goal you haven't saved: P(goal met), median path.

get.description:
The public journal's data. ``preview`` (the default here) includes draft entries, marked;
the published site is built with ``preview=false`` and never contains drafts.

ArmPoint.title: ArmPoint
ArmPoint.description: One matured post in an experiment: its outcome as a share of its own frozen forecast.

BriefingData.title: BriefingData
BriefingData.description: The structured part of a run briefing (services/briefing.py ``build``).

Calibration.title: Calibration
Calibration.description: Share of scored posts whose outcome fell inside the frozen 50% and 80% ranges.

ChangeRowOut.title: ChangeRowOut
ChangeRowOut.description: A dated change that can shift performance: ranker changes, model releases, goals.

CurvePoint.title: CurvePoint
CurvePoint.description: The frozen 48h forecast mapped to an earlier or later age with the forecast's maturity curve.

CustomSpecIn.title: CustomSpecIn
CustomSpecIn.description: A one-factor per-post experiment written by the owner.

DayPlan.title: DayPlan
DayPlan.description:
One whole local day of slots. ``treatment_slots`` is for switchbacks whose lever changes the
slots themselves (posting window, frequency): the day's drawn condition picks the list.

ExpectedRange.title: ExpectedRange
ExpectedRange.description: The 10/50/90% quantiles of a KPI's predictive distribution and where the actual landed.

ExpectedVsActual.title: ExpectedVsActual
ExpectedVsActual.description: A past expectation and how the actual landed against it (MODEL §4.1 thresholds).

FactorPastOut.title: FactorPastOut
FactorPastOut.description: How the factor's posts landed against their frozen treatment-blind forecasts (plan §6).

FollowerScoreOut.title: FollowerScoreOut
FollowerScoreOut.description: A frozen follower forecast whose horizon has passed, against the actual count.

GateOut.title: GateOut
GateOut.description: One release gate (MODEL §5). ``passed`` is None when it couldn't be evaluated.

GoalPreviewOut.title: GoalPreviewOut
GoalPreviewOut.description: Where the member would stand today against a goal they haven't saved yet.

HitRateTile.title: HitRateTile
HitRateTile.description: Share of matured posts whose outcome fell inside the frozen central interval.

PitHistogram.title: PitHistogram
PitHistogram.description: PIT of 48h impressions in 10 bins, last ``n`` originals and quotes. Flat means calibrated.

PlanIn.title: PlanIn
PlanIn.description: A post the member intends to publish. ``planned_at`` needs an offset; it is stored in UTC.

PowerPreviewOut.title: PowerPreviewOut
PowerPreviewOut.description: MODEL §6.8's three numbers at the account's posting rate.

ProposeIn.title: ProposeIn
ProposeIn.description: Start one of E01-E09 (``suggestion``) or a custom experiment (``custom``), as the owner.

PublicPostRow.title: PublicPostRow
PublicPostRow.description: A post in a weekly entry's table, against its frozen forecast.

RegisterSlotsIn.title: RegisterSlotsIn
RegisterSlotsIn.description:
Whole local days, each with its slot times (local, the account's zone) and optional labels
such as ``content_kind=demo`` or ``link_post=true`` that factors filter on.

SkillTile.title: SkillTile
SkillTile.description: Log-CRPS skill against the trailing-median baseline, week-block bootstrap 90% interval.
